title: Halo media slot
description: A framed slot for any photo, video or product shot: 4px corners, no border or shadow. Empty, it shows a soft glow-tinted surface at the requested aspect ratio, so the layout is right before the real image arrives.
notes: fill it with an img or video: it is cropped to fill the frame
empty: dark tone is a graphite surface with an orange glow, light tone a muted paper surface
